t: The Timeguard SLFM360N is a discreet, flush-mount PIR ceiling sensor engineered for reliable automatic lighting control in diverse indoor environments. This white motion sensor is ideal for optimising energy use in commercial offices, public corridors, and domestic utility rooms. Featuring adjustable 'on' time from 3 seconds to 18 minutes and flexible lux settings, alongside a useful manual override function, it provides precise control for various lighting types, including 500W LED loads. Its robust polycarbonate construction and IP44 rating ensure durability for wired indoor installations. 360° detection angle, up to 8m diameter for motion, and 4m diameter for presence at a 2.5m mounting height. Suitable for 2000W resistive, 500W. LED/Fluorescent or Low energy loads or 75W Fan
